hook: Microsoft Copilot is evolving from an assistant into an autonomous worker.
spoken_script: Microsoft Copilot is evolving from an assistant into an autonomous worker. Microsoft unveiled Autopilot agents—autonomous background systems that build apps, balance budgets, and resolve IT tickets across Office 365. Rather than waiting for prompts, Autopilot orchestrates entire workflows inside sandboxed Azure containers. Enterprise controls enforce strict human approvals before high-stakes database writes.
